name: Konami
source:
[url=/c12299]Chris[/url]'s childhood friend before left his old town. Konami is a trendy, cheerful and optimistic girl with almost as much energy as [url=/c12305]Mii[/url] and just as much naiveness. She rarely thinks of the consequences of her actions. When she starts attending [url=/c12302]Mai[/url]'s school, she and Mai become best friends.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Konami]Wikipedia[/url].]
